title: viola ovato-oblonga
intro: Viola ovato-oblonga, commonly known as Field Pansy or Pansy Violet, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the violet family (Violaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Viola ovato-oblonga include its ability to act as a nervine, soothing the nervous system, and as an anti-anxiety agent, reducing anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
